proposal.inferred_root_cause: transit-level timeout against upi:okhdfcbank, which is answering 92% of attempts normally
proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:okhdfcbank is healthy on the rolling window at 92% success over 148 attempts against a 91% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names upi:okaxis, a different issuer on the same method. A timeout while the issuer is answering everyone else puts the fault in transit, not at the bank; the authorisation may even have landed and lost its response. The open notice on upi:okaxis is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 2 failing the same way weakens the transient reading, which is why confidence is below a first failure. The session is live, but the issuer is fine and the same rail will almost certainly work, so moving the payer would spend friction on a problem that has already passed: retry on upi_intent after 1m, long enough for a transit fault to clear and short enough that the order is still warm.
